notes.title: Updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we just want to let you guys know that we do pay attention to your comments both in here and over at our facebook fanpage. 

So we know that most of our players don't like the "Gotcha" traps in the game and the overrall amount of time you die playing, so we just made an update to make your experience more fun and less frustrating. 

Update Change log:
[list]

[*]All "Gotcha" traps have now a small marker so if you pay attention you can easily spot where a trap is.

[*]Fixed a recurrent bug with the first boss's attacks.

[*]Boss fights are easier now.
[/list]

As a bonus we will be running a sale this week offering a 70% off, so if you were in doubt to get the game because of the reviews talking about the difficulty, this is a good opportunity for you to give us a chance to show you we do care about our player base and we do want to deliver good, fun games.

Cheers!

notes.title: Red Goblin Challenge (Win something)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today we will start 2 challenges for you:

1.- The Legend.
-Make a Let's play video of Red Goblin. Video must show that you finished the game.

-For this one the first to post will be considered the winner and win the title of "The Legend"

What do you win? We will add you as an NPC (Custom made just for you) called whatever you like (No offensive names allowed) In the "programmers void" You will tell the player that you are the first one to beat the game and that you are because of that "The Legend".

2.- "The Expert"

-Post a guide for the game (On steam or Gamefaqs)

-For this one we will wait until June 1st.

-If more that 1 guide is posted we will pick the more complete guide as the winner.

What will you win? You will be added in the game to! under the nick name "The Expert" And of course you will brag about how you find Red Goblin so easy to complete!



Have a great one!!

notes.title: New Version Uploaded!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone be sure you have version 1.18 now since we added some features asked by the community.

[h1]Version Changes:[/h1]
[List]
[*][FIX] Fixed a small bug with the boss barrier switch delaying/getting wrong input

[*][FIX] Fixed A small graphical glitch with the water on some parts.

[*][CHANGE] Game over screen is gone, now you restart from save after dead

[*][CHANGE] Boss Difficulty lowered a little.

[*][CHANGE] Water is not lethal, only slows you down.
[/List]

We hope you like it!
Please be sure to share your comments/suggestions!
